name: Legion X

features.name: xNudge Wilds
features.description: Nudge up or down, +1 multiplier per step.

features.name: Infectious Wilds
features.description: Turn a low symbol wild across the middle reels.

review:
Legion X is a 5x3 Roman slot that combines three xMechanics. xNudge Wilds nudge up or down and gain +1 per step. Infectious Wilds on reels 1 and 5 turn every instance of a random low symbol on the middle reels wild, and xWays on the outer reels reveal two to four matching symbols.

Because two mechanics share the outer reels, the middle of the grid is where wins come together. Nolimit rates it Extreme volatility, with a 31,000x cap.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
